game_title: Comparison Duel – Lava River Crossing Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing, a river of molten rock: the volcanologist must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the volcanologist's power beats the shield shown by cinder bats.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing: a river of molten rock
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava River Crossing, repeat each round: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the volcanologist's power beats the shield shown by cinder bats. Each round, cinder bats strike the forge anvil, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the power value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the forge anvil from cinder bats in Lava River Crossing: keep the power meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 48-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: power drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 48-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 7 (applied tier): Comparison Duel
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Lava River Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 48 seconds while power > 0.
